work.name: Texas A&M Institute for Genome Sciences & Society - Bioinformatics Core
work.summary: Researcher and instructor at Texas A&M University. Focused on providing bioinformatic analysis services to both internal and external clients ranging from differential gene expression to multiomic based comparative analyses.

work.name: Texas A&M University
work.summary: Instructor teaching various graduate student level classes including Differential Gene Expression (DGE), and protein structure prediction using AI/ML.

work.name: Texas A&M University
work.summary: Researcher and teaching assistant in the Texas A&M department of Biochemistry & Molecular Biophysics. My thesis work focused on hydrocarbon biosynthesis and comparative genomics in the green microalgae. My teaching focused on training undergraduate students on proper biochemical assay techniques. During my teaching, I co-developed a module on introducing undergraduates to protein structure prediction using aritifial intelligence.

academic & community service.summary: Served as a board member of TGS. Responsible for collecting and organizing sponsors for the annual meetings, and maintaining/updating the website.

Served as the vice president of the graduate student association, and additional volunteered to be the representative at the departmental in both the graduate progrom committee and student body government.

awards.title: Norman Borlaug Endowed Research Scholar Fellow
awards.summary: The Norman Borlaug Endowed Research Scholars Program will seek to recruit and retain agriculture and life sciences students interested in research. Areas of impact include animal sciences, plant sciences, nutrition sciences, food sciences, environmental sciences, agricultural engineering, education and leadership, and economics and policy.'
